info.title: Ad History API
info.description:
Access the world's most comprehensive advertising intelligence database with 18 years of historical ad data spanning tens of billions of ads across millions of advertisers. SpyFu's Ad History API provides complete campaign timelines from 2007 to present, covering 99.93% of advertisers who have ever run Google Ads campaigns.

Unlike competitors who offer limited historical snapshots, SpyFu captures every ad variation, A/B test, and optimization iteration. See how competitors evolved their ad copy over time to maximize conversions, learn from early mistakes they made and later removed, and gain unmatched competitive intelligence that goes back nearly two decades.

With data updated every 15 seconds across 28 countries and processing 40,000 search results per second, SpyFu maintains 20x more paid keyword data than SEMRush or Ahrefs. The closest competitor offers only 5 years of history with 1/20th the data volume.

This API complements SpyFu's other research APIs by focusing specifically on ad creative and copy history, while the Competitors API handles ranking relationships and the Keyword Research API covers search volume and competition data.

For complete documentation and interactive examples, visit the [SpyFu Developer Portal](https://www.spyfu.com/apis).

get.description:
Returns historical ad variations and copy for a specific domain. This endpoint focuses on ads from a particular advertiser across all their keywords and campaigns, unlike term-based endpoints that focus on specific keywords.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/ad-history/domain?query=example.com)

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Advertiser's root domain

parameters.name: keywordFilter
parameters.description: Filter down to keywords containing this value

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort order for grouped domain ad history results.

x-enumDescriptions.Best: Best performing keywords based on longevity, CPC, and testing frequency
x-enumDescriptions.Worst: Worst performing keywords that were tested and likely dropped

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of ad history records to return per page.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Starting row number for pagination.

200.description: Successfully retrieved ad history data for the specified domain. Returns a paginated list of historical ad variations with copy, keywords, and campaign information.

schema.description: Response wrapper containing domain ad history results with pagination metadata.

results.description: Array of ads with their associated keywords found for the specified domain.

keywords.description: List of keywords that triggered this ad to appear in search results.

position.description: The ad's position on the search results page when it was captured (1 = top position).

searchDateId.description: Date when this ad was captured by SpyFu's crawling system, formatted as YYYYMMDD (e.g., 20231215 = December 15, 2023).

title.description: The headline text of the ad as it appeared in search results.

body.description: The description text of the ad providing additional details about the offer.
examples: Discover premium running shoes with advanced cushioning technology. Shop now and save 20% on your first order.

url.description: The landing page URL that the ad directed users to when clicked.

adId.description: Unique identifier for this specific ad in SpyFu's database.

items.description: Represents an ad with associated keywords that triggered it to appear in search results.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., invalid domain format, pageSize exceeds maximum, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access ad history data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

get.description:
Returns historical advertisers and ad variations for a specific keyword. This endpoint focuses on ads that have appeared for a particular keyword, unlike domain-based endpoints that focus on ads from specific advertisers.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/keyword/ad-history?query=example%20keyword)

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Keyword to retrieve advertising history for.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of ad history records to return per page.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Starting row number for pagination.

200.description: Successfully retrieved ad history data for the specified keyword. Returns a paginated list of ads that have appeared for this keyword across different advertisers.

schema.description: Response wrapper containing term ad history results with pagination metadata.

results.description: Array of ads found for the specified keyword with associated landing pages and advertiser information.

domainName.description: The domain name of the advertiser who placed this ad.

urls.description: List of landing page URLs that this ad directed users to when clicked.

position.description: The ad's position on the search results page when it was captured (1 = top position).

searchDateId.description: Date when this ad was captured by SpyFu's crawling system, formatted as YYYYMMDD (e.g., 20231215 = December 15, 2023).

title.description: The headline text of the ad as it appeared in search results.

body.description: The description text of the ad providing additional details about the offer.
examples: Discover premium running shoes with advanced cushioning technology. Shop now and save 20% on your first order.

adId.description: Unique identifier for this specific ad in SpyFu's database.

items.description: Represents ad data for a specific keyword with associated advertiser information and landing pages.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., empty term, pageSize exceeds maximum, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access ad history data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

get.summary: Get Keyword Ad History With Stats
get.description:
Returns historical ad variations and advertiser performance statistics for a specific keyword. This endpoint includes domain-level metrics alongside ad copy data, unlike the basic ad history endpoint that focuses purely on ad variations.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/keyword/ad-history?query=example%20keyword)

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Keyword to retrieve advertising history for.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country code to filter results by geographic market.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of ad history records to return per page.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Starting row number for pagination.

200.description: Successfully retrieved ad history data with advertiser statistics for the specified keyword. Returns a paginated list of ads with performance metrics and domain-level data.

schema.description: Response wrapper containing comprehensive term ad history statistics including advertiser analysis and top-performing ads.

domains.description: Array of domains (advertisers) that have purchased ads for the specified keyword, ranked by performance metrics.

ads.description: Collection of ads this domain has purchased for the specified keyword.

searchDateId.description: Date when this ad was captured by SpyFu's crawling system, formatted as YYYYMMDD (e.g., 20231215 = December 15, 2023).

position.description: The ad's position on the search results page when it was captured (1 = top position).

title.description: The headline text of the ad as it appeared in search results.

body.description: The description text of the ad providing additional details about the offer.
examples: Discover premium running shoes with advanced cushioning technology. Shop now and save 20% on your first order.

domainName.description: The domain name of the advertiser who placed this ad.

fullUrl.description: The complete landing page URL that the ad directed users to when clicked.

term.description: The search keyword that triggered this ad to appear in search results.

adCount.description: The number of times this specific ad variation was observed during the capture period.

isLeaderboardAd.description: Indicates whether this ad appeared in the top ad positions (leaderboard) rather than sidebar positions.

items.description: Represents a single ad from SpyFu's historical advertising database with complete ad copy and metadata.

budget.description: Estimated monthly advertising budget this domain spends on the specified keyword.

coverage.description: Percentage of time this domain appears in ads for the specified keyword (0-100).

domainName.description: The domain name of the advertiser.

percentageLeaderboard.description: Percentage of time this domain's ads appear in top positions (leaderboard) rather than sidebar positions.

totalAdsPurchased.description: Total number of ads this domain has purchased across all keywords in SpyFu's database.

adCount.description: Number of ads this domain has purchased specifically for the requested keyword.

items.description: Represents an advertiser (domain) that purchases ads for a specific keyword, including their ad performance metrics and budget estimates.

topAds.description: Array of the most successful ads for the specified keyword, ranked by performance and frequency metrics.

adId.description: Unique identifier for this specific ad in SpyFu's database.

averagePosition.description: Average position where this ad appeared on search results pages across all observations.

averageAdCount.description: Average total number of ads per capture period.

body.description: The description text of the ad providing additional details about the offer.
examples: Discover premium running shoes with advanced cushioning technology. Shop now and save 20% on your first order.

title.description: The headline text of the ad as it appeared in search results.

fullUrl.description: The complete landing page URL that the ad directed users to when clicked.

percentageLeaderboard.description: Percentage of time this ad appeared in top ad positions versus sidebar positions.

get.summary: Get Domain Ad History by Date
get.description:
Returns one row per keyword, search date, and ad variation for a domain. Use the date bounds and paging fields to pull a controlled slice while still seeing the total matching result size.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/ad-history/domain?query=example.com)

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Advertiser's root domain.

parameters.name: keywordFilter
parameters.description: Only include keywords containing this text.

parameters.name: minSearchDateId
parameters.description: Earliest ad capture date to include, formatted as YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: maxSearchDateId
parameters.description: Latest ad capture date to include, formatted as YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Starting row number for pagination.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of flattened ad history rows to return per page.

parameters.name: keywordStartingRow
parameters.description: Keyword/domain document row number to start the backing query with before flattening date rows. KeywordStartingRow plus KeywordPageSize must fit within the first 10,000 keyword/domain documents.

parameters.name: keywordPageSize
parameters.description: Number of keyword/domain documents to fetch before flattening date rows. KeywordStartingRow plus KeywordPageSize must fit within the first 10,000 keyword/domain documents.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

200.description: Successfully retrieved flattened domain ad history rows and result-size metadata for the requested date range.

schema.description: Response wrapper containing flattened domain ad history rows with paging and full-match metadata.

totalMatchingResults.description: Total flattened keyword/date/ad rows found in the fetched keyword window after the date and keyword filters are applied.

totalMatchingResultsIsPartial.description: True when more keyword/domain documents exist outside this response's backing query window, so totalMatchingResults is only the flattened count for this keyword window.

resultCount.description: Number of flattened keyword/date/ad rows returned in this response.

startingRow.description: Starting row number used for this page.

pageSize.description: Requested maximum number of rows returned in this page.

hasMoreResults.description: True when more flattened rows are available after this page.

totalMatchingKeywords.description: Total keyword/domain documents matched by the backing query before flattening date rows.

keywordStartingRow.description: Keyword/domain document row number used to start the backing query.

keywordPageSize.description: Requested maximum number of keyword/domain documents fetched by the backing query.

resultWindowKeywordCount.description: Number of keyword/domain documents returned by the backing query for this response.

hasMoreKeywordResults.description: True when more keyword/domain documents are available after this backing query window.

results.description: Flattened keyword/date/ad rows for the requested page.

keyword.description: Keyword that triggered this ad for the requested domain.

termId.description: Internal SpyFu identifier for the keyword.

searchDateId.description: Date when this ad was captured by SpyFu's crawling system, formatted as YYYYMMDD (e.g., 20240101 = January 1, 2024).

position.description: Paid ad position observed for this ad on the search results page.

title.description: Headline text used in the ad.

body.description: Body copy used in the ad.
examples: Shop paint sprayers, rollers, brushes, and supplies.

domainName.description: Advertiser domain that served the ad.

fullUrl.description: Full final destination URL captured for this ad variation.

adId.description: SpyFu identifier for the ad creative.

isLeaderboardAd.description: Whether this ad was observed in a leaderboard placement.

items.description: A single flattened domain ad history row for one keyword, date, and ad variation.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., invalid date bounds, pageSize exceeds maximum, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access ad history data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

Basic_Authentication_Token.description:
Basic Authentication is a standard that involves encoding your SPYFU_API_ID:SECRET_KEY into a Base64 string. Your SpyFu API ID and Secret Key can both be found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page. Additionally, you can find the Base64 string has been pre-generated on the same page under Base 64 Key. Finally, this encoded string is sent in the "Authorization" header prefixed with the keyword "Basic":
For example, to authorize as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:AB12WXYZ the client would send
Authorization: Basic MDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwOkFCMTJXWFla

Query_Parameter_Token.description:
An API key can be added as a query parameter. Your API key is listed as "Secret Key" found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page
For example, to authorize with the API key AB12WXY
/apis/example_api/GetExample?domain=spyfu.com&api_key=AB12WXYZ
Query_Parameter_Token.name: api_key

HMAC_Authentication_Header.description:
For even more security, each request can be individually authenticated with a timestamped HMAC (Hash Message Authentication Code) signature. Composed of your secret key, a valid timestamp, the API request path, and all request parameters.

Creating the signature:


Combine the pieces that will be converted into the signature.
StringToSign =
	HTTP-Verb + "
" +
	Timestamp + "
" +
	UrlPath + "
"
	QueryParameters;

Create UTF-8 encodings of the above string and of your secret key.
byte[] SecretKeyBytes = UTF-8-Encoding-Of( Upper-Case-Of( SECRET_KEY ) );
byte[] StringToSignBytes = UTF-8-Encoding-Of( StringToSign );

Use an implementation of HMAC256 using your UTF-8 secret key to encode the combined string of your request. This should then be converted to Base64 to finish creating your signature.
Signature = Base64( HMAC-SHA256( SecretKeyBytes, StringToSignBytes ) );

Using the signature:


This signature is then sent in through an Authentication header with your username.
Authentication: UserName:Signature
HMAC_Authentication_Header.name: Authentication
